question: In a flight time analyzer in mass spectrometry:

options.opa: Ions with low m / z or lighter values ​​arrive more quickly at the detector.
options.opb: Ions with high m / z or heavier values ​​arrive more quickly at the detector.
options.opc: The ions do not reach the detector.
options.opd: Ions with odd m / z ratio arrive more quickly at the detector.
options.ope: The analysis time that is usually required is seconds.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Ions with low m/z or lighter values ​​ -> arrive more quickly at the detector -> 80% CHAIN: Ions with high m/z or heavier values ​​ -> arrive more slowly at the detector -> 90% CHAIN: Ions with odd m/z ratio -> may have unique behavior in flight time analysis -> 70% CHAIN: The ions do not reach the detector -> indicates a malfunction or incorrect setup -> 95% CHAIN: The analysis time that is usually required is seconds -> indicates a rapid process -> 80%
